name: UFC | svc.list_incidents_to_diagnose
description: Returns up to 3 open, alerted incidents that need a diagnosis and claims them for the caller (agent or workflow), so two diagnosers never take the same one.

parameters.jsCode:
const c=$('Select Incidents To Diagnose').first().json.claims;
return c.length?c.map(x=>({json:x})):[{json:{incident_key:null}}];

const s=$('Select Incidents To Diagnose').first().json;
return [{json:{count:s.count,incidents:s.incidents}}];
